items.example: The secretary described the proceedings as a farce.
items.cloze: The secretary described the proceedings as ______.
items.analysis_zh: 公开否定某个事件或程序的严肃性。
items.why_zh: 公开否定某个事件或程序的严肃性。

items.example: The accusations concerned military decisions, among other things.
items.analysis_zh: among other things 可放在句末，为新闻信息留出概括空间。
items.cloze: The accusations concerned military decisions, ______.
items.hint_zh: 用于概括列举但未穷尽的事项。
items.why_zh: among other things 可放在句末，为新闻信息留出概括空间。

items.example: The firm hopes to raise as much as $64bn through its listing.
items.analysis_zh: 在金额前用 as much as 引出上限，避免误读为确定融资金额。
items.cloze: The firm hopes to raise ______ $64bn through its listing.
items.hint_zh: 常用于强调大额上限，注意与 as many as 的可数差别。
items.why_zh: 在金额前用 as much as 引出上限，避免误读为确定融资金额。

items.example: The governing party blocked an attempt to remove the minister from office.
items.analysis_zh: 动词 block 用来描述程序性阻止提案或动议。
items.cloze: The governing party ______ remove the minister from office.
items.hint_zh: 结构：block an attempt to do something。
items.why_zh: 动词 block 用来描述程序性阻止提案或动议。

items.meaning_zh: （长期问题）发展到关键爆发点
items.example: The longstanding dispute over judicial appointments came to a head this week.
items.analysis_zh: 常见主语是 dispute、crisis、tensions。
items.cloze: The longstanding dispute over judicial appointments ______ this week.
items.hint_zh: 使用过去式 came；突出长期累积的矛盾到了临界点。
items.why_zh: 常见主语是 dispute、crisis、tensions。

items.example: The government said it would carry out the sentence.
items.cloze: The government said it would ______.
items.analysis_zh: carry out 可用于执行计划、命令和法院判决。
items.why_zh: carry out 可用于执行计划、命令和法院判决。

items.example: Opposition parties denounced the suspension.
items.cloze: Opposition parties ______.
items.analysis_zh: denounce 的批评力度比 criticise 更强。
items.why_zh: denounce 的批评力度比 criticise 更强。

items.example: The latest round of negotiations did little to halt the fighting.
items.analysis_zh: did little to 比 failed to 更含蓄，报道对冲突的实际影响时很常见。
items.cloze: The latest round of negotiations ______ halt the fighting.
items.hint_zh: 后接动词原形，表示对某种结果影响有限。
items.why_zh: did little to 比 failed to 更含蓄，报道对冲突的实际影响时很常见。

items.example: Higher housing costs have eroded workers' purchasing power.
items.analysis_zh: erode 与 margins、confidence、living standards 搭配自然。
items.cloze: Higher housing costs have ______ workers' purchasing power.
items.hint_zh: 描述生活水平或利润率逐渐受损，语气比 destroyed 更符合经济报道。
items.why_zh: erode 与 margins、confidence、living standards 搭配自然。

items.example: The old rules violated fundamental rights.
items.cloze: The old rules violated ______.
items.analysis_zh: 用于法律新闻中受到保护的核心权利。
items.why_zh: 用于法律新闻中受到保护的核心权利。

items.example: Unions declared a general strike.
items.cloze: Unions declared a ______.
items.analysis_zh: general strike 表示多个行业参加的广泛罢工。
items.why_zh: general strike 表示多个行业参加的广泛罢工。

items.example: The court convicted the former leader in absentia.
items.analysis_zh: 常见搭配：tried / convicted / sentenced in absentia。
items.cloze: The court convicted the former leader ______.
items.hint_zh: 法律报道的拉丁语表达，表示被告本人没有出庭。
items.why_zh: 常见搭配：tried / convicted / sentenced in absentia。

items.example: The city was on edge after the shooting.
items.cloze: The city was ______ after the shooting.
items.analysis_zh: 形容在持续威胁或不确定性下精神紧绷。
items.why_zh: 形容在持续威胁或不确定性下精神紧绷。

items.example: The appeals court overturned the earlier ruling.
items.analysis_zh: 与 uphold（维持裁决）形成常用对比。
items.cloze: The appeals court ______ the earlier ruling.
items.hint_zh: 用于较高级别法院推翻先前决定。
items.why_zh: 与 uphold（维持裁决）形成常用对比。

items.example: Part of the funding could come from a private allocation of shares to strategic partners.
items.analysis_zh: 这一表达比泛泛的 investment 更精确地说明融资结构。
items.cloze: Part of the funding could come from ______ to strategic partners.
items.hint_zh: 金融新闻中的 allocation 可以指股份配售。
items.why_zh: 这一表达比泛泛的 investment 更精确地说明融资结构。

items.example: The demonstrations were prompted by an announcement about the former leader's return.
items.analysis_zh: prompted by 常用于交代示威、政策反应或价格波动的直接诱因。
items.cloze: The demonstrations were ______ an announcement about the former leader's return.
items.hint_zh: 被动结构后接名词，突出事件触发因素。
items.why_zh: prompted by 常用于交代示威、政策反应或价格波动的直接诱因。

items.example: Rates might increase by more than a quarter-point.
items.cloze: Rates might increase by more than ______.
items.analysis_zh: 利率报道常用 quarter-point 表示 0.25 个百分点。
items.why_zh: 利率报道常用 quarter-point 表示 0.25 个百分点。

items.example: The court viewed the rule as a relic from colonial rule.
items.cloze: The court viewed the rule as ______ colonial rule.
items.analysis_zh: relic from 用于形容不合时宜的历史遗留制度。
items.why_zh: relic from 用于形容不合时宜的历史遗留制度。

items.example: A senior official reportedly informed the president several months earlier.
items.analysis_zh: reportedly 是新闻归因词，写作时注意区分 confirmed 与 alleged。
items.cloze: A senior official ______ informed the president several months earlier.
items.hint_zh: 副词修饰整句，表明信息来自报道而非已经核实的事实。
items.why_zh: reportedly 是新闻归因词，写作时注意区分 confirmed 与 alleged。

items.meaning_zh: 实质性的；有实际内容的
items.example: The negotiators called the meeting substantive, though no agreement was signed.
items.analysis_zh: 新闻中的 substantive 可以评价讨论内容有分量，不直接承诺取得结果。
items.cloze: The negotiators called the meeting ______, though no agreement was signed.
items.hint_zh: 表示会谈涉及实质议题，比 productive 更审慎。
items.why_zh: 新闻中的 substantive 可以评价讨论内容有分量，不直接承诺取得结果。

items.example: Consumer prices rose faster than forecast, surpassing expectations.
items.analysis_zh: surpass 表示超出某种水平，常搭配 expectations、forecasts、targets。
items.cloze: Consumer prices rose faster than forecast, ______.
items.hint_zh: 现在分词作补充信息，浓缩与市场预测的比较。
items.why_zh: surpass 表示超出某种水平，常搭配 expectations、forecasts、targets。

items.meaning_zh: 覆盖广泛的大规模关税
items.example: Markets reacted sharply when the administration unveiled sweeping tariffs.
items.analysis_zh: 同样可以用 sweeping reforms、sweeping changes。
items.cloze: Markets reacted sharply when the administration unveiled ______.
items.hint_zh: sweeping 强调范围广、影响大。
items.why_zh: 同样可以用 sweeping reforms、sweeping changes。

items.example: The governing party is trailing behind its opponents.
items.cloze: The governing party is ______ its opponents.
items.analysis_zh: 可形容民调、竞赛或业绩表现落后。
items.why_zh: 可形容民调、竞赛或业绩表现落后。

items.example: Diplomats from three countries resumed trilateral talks in the Gulf.
items.analysis_zh: 政治外交新闻常用 trilateral 修饰 talks。
items.cloze: Diplomats from three countries resumed ______ in the Gulf.
items.hint_zh: 由 tri（三）和 lateral（方的）构成，概括三方参与的外交谈判。
items.why_zh: 政治外交新闻常用 trilateral 修饰 talks。

items.example: Bankers are reassessing the firm's valuation.
items.cloze: Bankers are reassessing ______.
items.analysis_zh: 资本市场新闻中估值与融资额存在区别。
items.why_zh: 资本市场新闻中估值与融资额存在区别。

passages.title: Ukraine · Negotiations and fighting
passages.body: Officials from America, Russia and Ukraine convened for {{2026-11-11-trilateral-talks}} in the Gulf after a long break in three-way meetings. Ukraine's president described the first discussion as {{2026-11-11-substantive}}, noting that humanitarian questions were on the agenda. Yet the diplomatic effort {{2026-11-11-did-little-to}} slow the fighting, and Ukraine reported fresh attacks on energy facilities.

passages.title: United States · An impeachment attempt
passages.body: In Washington, House Republicans {{2026-11-11-blocked-attempt}} impeach the defence secretary. The proposal accused him of waging war without congressional approval, {{2026-11-11-among-other-things}}. The secretary dismissed the matter as {{2026-11-11-a-farce}}. Democrats could revisit the issue once control of the chamber changes.

passages.title: Markets · Anthropic's planned IPO
passages.body: Anthropic is considering raising {{2026-11-11-as-much-as}} $64.4bn through its planned stock-market listing. It is also seeking capital through {{2026-11-11-private-allocation}} to other companies. Bankers are {{2026-11-11-reportedly}} discussing a higher estimate of {{2026-11-11-valuation}}. None of these proposed sums should be treated as money already raised.

passages.title: United States · Inflation and bond yields
passages.body: American consumer prices climbed by 0.4% in a month, {{2026-11-11-surpassing-expectations}}. Yields on Treasury bonds rose sharply as traders reconsidered the outlook for interest rates. The market reaction recalled the turmoil that followed the announcement of {{2026-11-11-sweeping-tariffs}} in 2025. Some investors now think borrowing costs might rise by more than {{2026-11-11-quarter-point}} at the next policy meeting.

passages.title: Bangladesh · A former leader's return
passages.body: Police in Bangladesh clashed with demonstrators at gatherings {{2026-11-11-prompted-by}} a former prime minister's plan to return home. She fled after a student-led uprising and was subsequently sentenced {{2026-11-11-in-absentia}}. She rejects the charges. A prosecutor warned that the authorities would {{2026-11-11-carry-out-sentence}} if she came back.

passages.title: Trinidad and Tobago · An appeal judgment
passages.body: An appeals court in Trinidad and Tobago {{2026-11-11-overturned}} laws that criminalised consensual relations between men. Judges said the restrictions violated {{2026-11-11-fundamental-rights}} and described the old bans as {{2026-11-11-relic-from}} British colonial rule. Campaigners hope the decision will encourage legal challenges elsewhere in the Commonwealth.

passages.title: Spain · Housing and labour protests
passages.body: Spanish unions called a nationwide {{2026-11-11-general-strike}} as frustration over housing costs intensified. Union leaders argue that rising rents have {{2026-11-11-eroded}} workers' living standards. The government has struggled to win support for its proposed rent controls, while the governing party is {{2026-11-11-trailing-behind}} its rivals in the polls.

passages.title: Poland · A judicial dispute
passages.body: Poland was {{2026-11-11-on-edge}} ahead of its Independence Day events, after a deadly shooting in Krakow. A long-running dispute over the constitutional court {{2026-11-11-came-to-a-head}} when the court's president was suspended. Opposition parties {{2026-11-11-denounced-the-suspension}}, sharpening the disagreement over the judiciary.
